description: This Java class configures security settings for a Spring Boot application, including CORS, authentication, authorization, and JWT filter integration.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for security settings, JWT filter, CORS, and authentication provider setup.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain, including CORS, CSRF disabling, session policy, request authorization, and adding JWT filter.

methods.name: corsConfiguration
methods.description: Creates and configures CORS settings, including allowed origins, methods, headers, and exposed headers.

methods.name: authenticationProvider
methods.description: Configures the DAO authentication provider with password encoder and user details service.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Provides a BCrypt password encoder with strength 12.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Retrieves the AuthenticationManager from the provided configuration.
